name: Raina Image Compression
author: rainafarai

sections.description:
Raina Image Compression is a powerful WordPress plugin to optimize images automatically while giving full control over compression and metadata.

Key features:

  • Reduce images to a specific pixel width
  • Works with the GD library
  • Control JPG quality from 0 to 100
  • Control PNG compression level from 0 to 10
  • Limit Compress images only when uploaded from the post editor
  • Automatically set ALT, Description, and Caption (Excerpt) using parent post information — easy for SEO
  • Show a toggle for image compression in the admin bar to quickly enable/disable without entering plugin settings
  • Receive Telegram alerts for compression events
  • Log plugin activity in WordPress debug log

This plugin is ideal for site owners who want fast-loading images, SEO-friendly metadata, and optional Telegram notifications.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the raina-image-compression folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin via the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Raina Image Compression to configure compression options, Telegram alerts, and admin bar toggle.
sections.faq:
Can I control the compression level?

Yes. You can set JPG quality from 0 to 100 and PNG compression from 0 to 10.

Can I limit compression to images uploaded from the post editor?

Yes. There is an option to compress images only when uploaded via the post editor.

Can the plugin automatically set ALT, Description, and Caption?

Yes. You can use the parent post information to automatically fill these fields for SEO purposes.

Can I quickly enable or disable compression?

Yes. You can show a toggle in the admin bar to turn compression on or off without going into the plugin settings.

Can I receive alerts via Telegram?

Yes. You can enable Telegram notifications for image compression events.

Can I log plugin activity in WordPress?

Yes. You can enable logging to see detailed plugin actions in the WordPress debug log.

Does it work with GD library?

Yes. GD library is used to handle image processing.
